note_text: Lymph node, inguinal lymph node, excisional biopsy: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. Immunohistochemistry: CD20 positive, CD10 positive, BCL6 positive, MUM1 negative. Cell of origin by Hans algorithm: GCB. MYC/BCL2 protein co-expression absent. Ki-67 74%. Specimen adequate for ancillary studies.

FDG PET/CT (baseline). Hypermetabolic lymphadenopathy in 3 nodal regions including inguinal lymph node, SUVmax 19.7. Non-contiguous extranodal involvement: liver. Impression: Lymphoma, Lugano stage IV.
FDG PET/CT (interim PET2). Deauville score 3. Complete metabolic response.
FDG PET/CT (end of treatment). Deauville score 2. Complete metabolic response.
FDG PET/CT: new hypermetabolic lesions (retroperitoneal lymph node). Relapsed lymphoma.
FDG PET/CT (end of treatment). Deauville score 3. Complete metabolic response.
